benchmark: No benchmark place lies in Marlborough. Negative-benchmark behaviour holds: operators and vehicles rejected (Greenshell Mussel Cruise, Beachcomber Mail Boat, Tui Nature Reserve), the road (Queen Charlotte Drive) rejected, a gateway whose draw is the journey beyond sent to review (French Pass, D'Urville Island), minor memorial/civic buildings rejected (Rutherford and Pickering Memorial, Renwick Library and Museum). Ninety Mile-style long-feature rule: Queen Charlotte Track stays under the Sounds, whose span holds both ends.
notes: Lowest-scoring kept have 0 Wikipedia views (no article) but 1-2 counted DOC/Wikivoyage sources, so 'stronger' left-outs are those with views > 0 or >= 2 sources; every one carries a concrete What-qualifies reason (area not a place, no counted source, closed to public, operator, part of larger spot, minor track). Reviews are listed for the owner and not placed.
